utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia — I’m trying to get a few hands-on helpers lined up for Saturday. I’ll send you the time as soon as I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Uli — just let me know the time and what you need me to bring, so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still lining up a few handy helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. If you know anyone else who can swing a hammer or lend a hand, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep an eye out and send anyone handy your way for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Sam, I’m organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I could really use a few helpers. Would you be able to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa — I can help on Saturday. I’ll be there on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it, Mina — I’ll send anyone handy your way. Just remind me about Saturday, and I’ll do my best to be there around 9.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. I’ll remind you about Saturday, and I appreciate you sending anyone handy my way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good—I’m down for Saturday out front, and I’ll keep an eye out for anyone handy to send Tess’s way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll note you for Saturday out front, and we can sort the tools when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll send anyone handy your way, Mina. Hope the porch repair drive gets the help it needs this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Sam. If you hear of anyone who can help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still lining up helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so if you know anyone handy, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to know the exact time and what tools you’ll need so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—Saturday morning on the front porch. If you need me there around 9, just say the word and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Oren. Let’s plan on 9 a.m. on the front porch, and I’ll have the tools and a few simple tasks ready for you.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
